thinking.description: 1-3 sentences reasoning about whether the retrieved facts actually answer the question. Never skip this.

anchor_resolved.description: Whether the facts you were given actually named the thing the question asks about.

grounded.description: True ONLY when the answer is directly backed by the facts provided in this prompt. Never true from your own general knowledge.

answer.description: Natural-language answer when grounded, or an explicit 'I don't know' style statement when not.

confidence.description: 'unknown' means no relevant fact was provided at all; the other five mirror the facts' own confidence.

evidence.description: Short quotes of the specific facts you actually used. Empty when not grounded.

open_question.description: Set has_question true whenever grounded is false, so the gap gets recorded instead of guessed.

question_text.description: The question to record for later follow-up. Empty string when has_question is false.

topic_hint.description: The entity/topic the question is about, if identifiable. Empty string otherwise.
